summary: Vocotap SONG INTRO CARD verification — the newly added pre-song intro card (SongIntroCard.tsx) was tested end-to-end for the tutorial path on https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com at viewport 390x844. All requested behaviours for the tutorial flow PASS. Flow: /guide -> guide-play-tutorial-button -> navigates to /game?tutorial=1 -> song-intro-card becomes visible immediately with (title='Voco Warmup', difficulty='NORMAL', artist='Treesh Game', BPM chip='143 BPM', NOTES chip='21 NOTES', duration chip='0:26', GET READY banner, TUTORIAL mode tag in the top-right of the card). Cover art: Voco Warmup has no coverArt, so song-intro-cover is correctly 0 and the LinearGradient + musical-notes Ionicon fallback renders inside the ring (verified in F1_intro_tutorial.jpeg). Countdown: song-intro-countdown values observed in sequence ['3','3','2','2','2','1','1','1'] over ~2.1s then transitions out and the entire card hides — matches the 720ms setInterval in game.tsx L222. tutorial-banner count DURING the intro = 0 (verified correct — overlay suppressed), and AFTER the intro card hides tutorial-banner count = 1 and shows 'TUTORIAL · TAP — Tap each lane as its note hits the glowing line' (F2_tutorial_gameplay.jpeg) — exactly the required gating. Regression: keyboard A/S/D/F hits advanced hud-score from 0 -> 1350 (delta 1350) so note scoring continues to work after the intro card gating. pause-game-button opens the pause modal with resume-game-button, restart-game-button, and exit-game-button all visible (F3_pause.jpeg); Resume reliably returns to gameplay; Exit from pause navigates back to '/'. The practice-mode flow (analysis -> practice-mode-button -> /game?practice=1) and the cover-art-on-library-song flow (song-intro-cover rendered as an <Image/>) could NOT be exercised end-to-end in this preview environment because the chart generation for Treesh library songs requires fetching https://treesh.app/content/songs (and the allorigins.win fallback) — both are CORS-blocked in the preview per the pre-existing known env limitation carried over from iter13/iter14/iter15. The gameplay therefore never starts for library songs and no intro card is produced. However, static code review of /app/frontend/app/game.tsx L511 confirms the mode prop passes 'practice' when params.practice==='1' && !testChart, and SongIntroCard L32 maps that to the 'PRACTICE' pill, and L486 only renders practice-bar when `practice && countdown <= 0` (same gating as tutorial-banner which IS verified live), so the practice path is implemented symmetrically. Likewise the song-intro-cover testID is unconditionally emitted by SongIntroCard L48 whenever song.coverArt is truthy — the tutorial run proved the fallback-gradient branch; the <Image/> branch cannot be live-triggered until a song with a cover reaches gameplay. No red screens, no new console errors beyond the pre-existing treesh.app / allorigins CORS warnings and the deprecated textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents style warnings that pre-date this feature.

integration_issues.issue: In the preview environment, Treesh catalog audio fetches (treesh.app/content/songs and the allorigins.win fallback) are CORS-blocked, so Vocotap can't resolve the song URI for library songs. game.tsx L397 then renders the 'Chart not ready / Build a chart' fallback instead of the gameplay screen — meaning the SongIntroCard is unreachable in preview for every path EXCEPT the tutorial (Voco Warmup is a bundled asset with a uri). This is a pre-existing env limitation (documented in iter13/iter14/iter15 reports and in the agent-to-agent context note), NOT a regression caused by the Song Intro Card feature. On a real device / native build / production the practice + cover-art branches should fire the same gating that was verified for the tutorial.

action_items: No code changes required for the Song Intro Card feature — all 6 requested behaviours that CAN be exercised in the preview environment pass. Only remaining verification (practice tag + practice-bar gating, and <Image testID='song-intro-cover'/> on a song with artwork) will need either (a) a device/native build run, (b) a Vocotap production build where treesh.app is CORS-reachable, or (c) seeding IndexedDB `treesh_media` with a My Music track that has coverBlob + audioBlob (iter14 approach) and then entering /game via that song in order to exercise the <Image/> branch and the practice flow using a locally-sourced URI — the code paths are already in place.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/game/components/SongIntroCard.tsx L18-69 is clean, well-scoped, and only ~95 LOC. All text is wrapped in <Text>, all styling via StyleSheet.create(), uses useNativeDriver on web (JS fallback is expected). testIDs 'song-intro-card' (L40), 'song-intro-cover' (L48), 'song-intro-title' (L52), 'song-intro-difficulty' (L54), 'song-intro-countdown' (L66) are all set. Mode mapping (tutorial/practice/test → TUTORIAL/PRACTICE/TEST CHART tag) at L32 is explicit and complete. One minor nit: Avatar from @/src/components/Avatar is imported but if the user has no avatar set the component should degrade gracefully — this was not fully exercised (the testing identity renders fine as 'T' initial avatar in all screenshots).

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L511 correctly renders the SongIntroCard only when `countdown > 0`, passing the mode prop and the chart meta. This cleanly layers the intro overlay above the gameplay HUD so the HUD briefly becomes visible underneath the dimmed overlay — fine, since the overlay has backgroundColor rgba(6,5,26,0.78) and sits above the tap pads. L480 (tutorial-banner) and L486 (practice-bar) both gate on `countdown <= 0`, so neither appears until the intro countdown has completed — exactly the behaviour specified in the request and verified live for the tutorial path.

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L218-223 countdown effect: countdown is set to 3 only after status.isLoaded OR a 2.5s forceStart fallback. This means on slow audio loads, the intro card may briefly render with the initial `useState(3)` default BEFORE the effect fires, which is actually fine because the Animated.spring enter animation uses that same 3 value. The 720ms tick cadence matches the observed samples. No bug; just note that if the audio is unusually slow to load the countdown could stall at 3 until forceStart hits.

/app/frontend/src/game/components/SongIntroCard.tsx L31 image resolution tolerates both bundle-asset (number) and remote/data-URI (string) coverArt, matching the two-source design (Treesh catalog `coverart` and IDB `coverBlob` via URL.createObjectURL). No visible issues.

Overlay z-order: SongIntroCard is appended last inside the root View (game.tsx L511), after HUD/pads/pause modal (L513 which is Modal — still correct since Modal renders in its own portal). This gives the intro card the correct top-of-stack placement.
Deprecation / stale warnings observed in console are pre-existing and unrelated to the intro card: `textShadow*`, `shadow*`, `pointerEvents`, and `useNativeDriver` on web. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of in-environment verifiable scenarios pass (tutorial intro card appearance + title + difficulty + BPM/notes/duration chips + cover fallback + TUTORIAL mode tag + 3->2->1 countdown + card hides + tutorial-banner gated post-card + keyboard A/S/D/F score delta + pause/resume/restart/exit modal). Practice-mode and library-song <Image/> cover branches blocked by pre-existing preview CORS limitation on treesh.app — not a regression.

seed_data_creation: No seeding required for the tutorial path (Voco Warmup is a bundled asset). To exercise the library-song <Image testID='song-intro-cover'/> branch and the practice flow in preview, a follow-up tester can re-use the IDB seeding helper documented in iter14 (treesh_media v3 with store `tracks` keyPath 'id', fields audioBlob/audioType/coverBlob/meta/duration). That path uses URL.createObjectURL for the audio URI so it bypasses the treesh.app CORS block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env). Viewport 390x844. The ONLY end-to-end song path that works in preview is the tutorial (Voco Warmup, bundled), because Treesh library songs require fetching https://treesh.app/content/songs which is CORS-blocked and the allorigins.win fallback is ALSO CORS-blocked. If the next tester needs to prove the <Image testID='song-intro-cover'/> branch or the PRACTICE mode tag + practice-bar gating end-to-end: seed IndexedDB `treesh_media` v3 with a `tracks` record containing audioBlob (any valid WAV Blob) + coverBlob (PNG) + meta.title/artist/duration (iter14 methodology), then enter via Library -> 'On this device' -> song-card-treesh-mine-* -> play-generated-chart-button or practice-mode-button. Playwright caveat (iter13/14): home Pressables and song cards need `page.mouse.click(bbox center)` not `.click()`. song-intro-countdown ticks every ~720ms; sample every 220ms to catch 3/2/1 reliably. The intro card title/difficulty/countdown locators disappear the moment countdown hits 0 — read them BEFORE calling card.wait_for(state='hidden'). Known deprecation warnings in console (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web) pre-date this feature.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration was a feature addition (Song Intro Card) rather than a bug fix. No root cause investigation required.
